nodes.label: Chrono_multicore library target
nodes.rationale: Self-disables without OpenMP or Thrust. Configures Thrust with both THRUST_DEVICE_SYSTEM and THRUST_HOST_SYSTEM set to OMP (unlike the FSI SPH module, which targets CUDA/HIP), and defines EIGEN_DONT_PARALLELIZE to stop Eigen from spawning nested OpenMP threads inside Chrono's own parallel regions.

nodes.label: Multicore iterative solver family (APGD, BB, MINRES, Jacobi, CG, GS, SPGQP)
nodes.rationale: All variants sit behind ChSolverMulticore / ChIterativeSolverMulticore and share the ChDataManager state and the ChSchurProduct operator, so alternative solvers are interchangeable without touching the physics system.
